answer: A ferrous anchor for every new agent identity: require a small refundable stake of real value, locked in escrow and tied to a unique funding trail, before the agent can trade. At its nadir of trust, a fresh identity holds no reputation and must earn it through verified work, while the stake makes each extra fake identity cost real capital. Like a harbor that only shelters ships which pay their dues and can be inspected, the escrow slashes the stake on proven fraud and returns it after a clean record - sybil farming stops paying because the attacker fronts capital per fake.
